name: shared-mask
title: One mask preserves row alignment
description: An illustrative table applies one Boolean row mask to distance, velocity and uncertainty so rows 0 and 3 stay aligned, while contrasting separate per-column masks that both return length 3 and silently pair row 2's 2100 km/s velocity with row 1's 30 km/s error.

name: array-views
title: A NumPy slice is a view into shared memory; .copy() allocates new memory
description: Starting from original = np.array([10, 20, 30, 40]), assigning view[0] = 99 on view = original[:2] mutates the shared memory buffer so original becomes [99, 20, 30, 40], whereas separate = original[:2].copy() allocates independent memory so separate[0] = -5 leaves original intact.

name: broadcasting
title: Broadcast one scale per object
description: A feature matrix of shape N by 3 is multiplied by a column of N row scales, producing another N by 3 matrix. Each scale applies across one object's three features.

name: catalogue-selection
title: Filtering and survey selection are separate decisions
description: The 400-row synthetic catalogue loses five invalid rows. Of 395 usable rows, the magnitude cut retains 262 and excludes 133. Histograms compare the usable and selected populations with common bins.

name: fits-vs-ecsv
title: ECSV stores text + YAML metadata; FITS packs Header + Data Units (HDUs)
description: Side-by-side comparison of ECSV plain-text YAML metadata headers (preserving units, datatypes and arbitrary nested table.meta dicts above CSV rows) against FITS binary multi-HDU containers (Primary Header plus Binary Table HDU with TTYPEn, TFORMn and TUNITn cards whose strict 8-character keyword rules reject arbitrary nested meta dicts).

name: nyquist-aliasing
title: Frequencies above Nyquist fold back into the resolved [0, fs/2] band
description: At a 512 Hz sampling rate with Nyquist limit 256 Hz, a 40 Hz tone stays resolved at 40 Hz, whereas a 300 Hz tone (256 + 44 Hz) folds across the 256 Hz mirror to an alias at 212 Hz (512 - 300 = 256 - 44 Hz) that is indistinguishable at 1/512 s discrete samples.

name: git-states
title: A commit records the staged snapshot
description: A first test-file version is staged, then edited again. Without staging the new edit, the next local commit contains the earlier snapshot.

name: git-branches
title: Resolve two descriptions before the merge commit
description: Two branches change the same README paragraph. Their shared history joins in a merge commit after the conflict is resolved to preserve both units and shortest-arc meaning.

name: git-undo-vs-revert
title: Private reset rewinds the branch pointer; shared revert adds a new inverse commit
description: Two timelines from C1 (good) to C2 (mistake): git reset --soft HEAD~1 rewinds private branch recovery-lab back to C1 while keeping C2's changes staged to fix and recommit, whereas git revert HEAD and git push keep C2 in shared history and add inverse commit C3 so collaborators fast-forward safely.

name: git-remotes
title: Local commits, remote branches and hosted review
description: Push updates hosted branches; fetch updates local remote-tracking references. A pull request compares hosted branches for review. Fetch alone does not edit the working files.

name: agent-architecture
title: Locate the client, model and tool execution
description: In a laptop Cline session, Qwen inference runs on CPD, while permission-controlled file and terminal tools run with the client. An OS shell sandbox is a separate boundary only in tools that provide one.

name: agent-review-loop
title: Keep scientific expectations under human control
description: A student supplies the task and independently justified expectations, reviews an agent plan and derives test cases, reviews the drafted test_student_checks.py, verifies the failing run and commits a fixed tests checkpoint before authorising the weighted_mean.py repair, then reruns independently and inspects the diff before accepting.
